svg.title: GeeTest: match order, then click
svg.desc: A: crop the icon board, detect candidate boxes and match the prompt using local vision. B: map bitmap centers to CSS coordinates, click in order and confirm. Retry only the widget up to three attempts.
svg.text: Match one target at a time
B / Click in the original tab
CSS x = left + centerX / bitmapW × CSS width
Same mapping for y; include iframe transforms
Still visible → refresh the widget; at most 3 attempts. Never replay the form.
Verification cleared ≠ login complete ≠ application received.
